{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_enable;
        wire [15:0] group_winner;
        wire [15:0] local_winner [0:15];
        wire [3:0] local_encoded [0:15];
        wire [15:0] low_terms [0:3];
        wire [15:0] high_terms [0:3];

        genvar g, i, b;
        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            assign group_valid[g] = |input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            if (g == 15) begin : top_group
                assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : other_group
                assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];

            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin : positions
                if (i == 15) begin : top_position
                    assign local_winner[g][i] = input_unencoded[g*16+i];
                end else begin : other_position
                    assign local_winner[g][i] = input_unencoded[g*16+i] &
                        ~(|input_unencoded[g*16+15:g*16+i+1]);
                end
                if (g == 0 && i == 0) begin : default_position
                    // The reference decodes index zero even when no input is set.
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+i] = group_enable[g] &
                        ~(|input_unencoded[15:1]);
                end else begin : normal_position
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+i] = group_enable[g] & local_winner[g][i];
                end
            end

            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encode_local
                wire [15:0] terms;
                for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin : encode_positions
                    if ((i >> b) & 1) begin : included
                        assign terms[i] = local_winner[g][i];
                    end else begin : excluded
                        assign terms[i] = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                assign local_encoded[g][b] = |terms;
                assign low_terms[b][g] = group_enable[g] & local_encoded[g][b];
                if ((g >> b) & 1) begin : included_group
                    assign high_terms[b][g] = group_winner[g];
                end else begin : excluded_group
                    assign high_terms[b][g] = 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end

        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : final_encode
            assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms[b];
            assign output_encoded[b+4] = |high_terms[b];
        end
        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    end else begin : generic_encoder
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        genvar l, n;

        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_input
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb_input
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end

        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_compress
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb_compress
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference propagates encoded bits through an eight-level binary priority tree and then decodes the resulting index to generate the 256-bit one-hot output. The cascaded selection and final decoding can dominate maximum data arrival.",
  "rewrite": "For the fixed configuration, partition the input into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local highest-set-bit masks and group priority in parallel. Generate the one-hot output directly from local winners and group enables, eliminating the encoded-to-one-hot decoder. Encode the lower four index bits from selected local encodings and the upper four bits from group winners. Retain the reference implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The intended improvement is a shallower reduction-and-gating path, particularly for output_unencoded, instead of serial priority multiplexing followed by decoding. Actual maximum-arrival improvement must be established with the specified SKY130HD mapping and STA; no numerical gain is claimed without those runs.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel local winner masks and group-enable distribution trade additional reduction logic and fanout for less serial selection. Synthesis can share reduction terms. Mapped area, buffering, electrical checks, and compliance with the 8862.124480 um2 cap remain to be measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Purely combinational, with unchanged ports, parameter declarations, priority, and output widths. In the optimized configuration, the highest asserted input index wins. An all-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=1, matching the reference rather than suppressing the one-hot output. Other parameter configurations use the reference tree, preserving its padding, truncation, and empty-input behavior. No state, latency, assumptions, undefined outputs, or external helpers are introduced."
}
